tool.name: Result Heatmap
tool.description: Generate an interactive heatmap visualization from TSV data containing classification results and performance metrics.

param.name: input_file
param.label: Input TSV File
param.help: A tab-separated values file with classification results. Must have a 'name' column as the row index.

param.name: column_list
param.label: Column Indices to Plot (Optional).
param.help: Comma-separated column indices to plot (e.g., 1,2,3 or 1,6,11,16,21). Uses 1-based indexing. Leave empty to plot all columns.

param.name: width
param.label: Figure Width (Pixels)
param.help: The width of the output figure in pixels.

param.name: height
param.label: Figure Height (Pixels)
param.help: The height of the output figure in pixels.

param.name: color_labels
param.label: Color Palette
param.help: The Plotly color scheme for the heatmap.

param.name: font_size
param.label: Cell Text Font Size
param.help: The font size for the values displayed in the heatmap cells.

param.name: tick_font
param.label: Axis Tick Font Size
param.help: The font size for the axis tick labels.

param.name: tick_angle
param.label: X-Axis Tick Angle (Degrees)
param.help: The rotation angle of the x-axis tick labels (negative values = bottom-right diagonal).

param.name: threshold
param.label: Performance Threshold
param.help: The threshold value for classifying performance comparisons.

tool.help:
**Result Heatmap Tool**
This tool generates an interactive heatmap visualization from TSV data containing classification results.
**Input Format:**
The input TSV file must have: - A 'name' column (first column) containing row identifiers - Multiple metric columns (e.g., F1 score, Accuracy, Precision, Recall, etc.) - Each row represents a classifier or method being evaluated
**Parameters:**
- **Input TSV File**: Tab-separated values file with classification results data. Must have a 'name' column as the row index. - **Column Indices to Plot (Optional)**: Comma-separated 1-based column indices to plot. Leave empty to plot all columns. Example: '1,2,3' or '1,6,11,16,21' - **Figure Width**: Width of the output figure in pixels (default: 2460) - **Figure Height**: Height of the output figure in pixels (default: 800) - **Color Palette**: Plotly color scheme for the heatmap visualization (default: Greens) - **Cell Text Font Size**: Font size for the values displayed in the heatmap cells (default: 22) - **Axis Tick Font Size**: Font size for the x and y axis labels (default: 26) - **X-Axis Tick Angle**: Rotation angle of the x-axis labels in degrees. Negative values rotate to the bottom-right (default: -80) - **Performance Threshold**: Threshold value for comparing classifier performance (default: 0.05)
**Border Color Legend:**
- **Violet**: Classifier performs better than all reference classifiers (≥threshold) - **Red**: Classifier performs better than some reference classifiers - **Blue**: Classifier is comparable with all reference classifiers - **Black**: Classifier is comparable with some reference classifiers
**Output:**
An interactive HTML heatmap that can be viewed in any web browser. The heatmap includes: - Performance metrics displayed as a color-coded grid - Cell values showing the exact metric values - Border highlights indicating classifier performance categories - Legend explaining the border color meanings
**Workflow:**
1. Read the input TSV file with classification results 2. Analyze each classifier's performance by comparing metric values 3. Categorize classifiers based on performance thresholds 4. Generate an interactive heatmap with color-coded highlights and a legend
**Example:**
For a TSV file with classifiers (rows) and metrics such as F1, Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and AUC: - Select columns 1,2,3 to plot only the first three metrics - Adjust colors and fonts for better readability - Set threshold to 0.1 for stricter performance comparison
